description_en: Retrieves all managed clusters for the current user
description_zh: 获取当前用户所有已纳管的集群
kebab_example: aliyun sysom list-clusters --current 1 --page-size 10 --name proxy-next-upstream --cluster-id cb7d4cc26c8f845fb8a8255ffd394820e --cluster-status Running --cluster-type ACK --id cb7d4cc26c8f845fb8a8255ffd394820e --region cn-hangzhou
name: ListClusters

parameters.help_en: The current page number (starting from page 1)
parameters.name: current

parameters.help_en: The number of entries per page
parameters.name: page_size

parameters.help_zh: 通过插件的名字过滤插件
parameters.name: name

parameters.help_en:
Filters by cluster ID.

This cluster ID is not the ACK cluster ID. It is the `id` field returned by this operation
parameters.help_zh:
通过集群 ID 过滤

这个集群ID不是 ACK 集群ID，而是通过本接口返回的数据里面的 `id` 字段
parameters.name: cluster_id

parameters.help_en:
`Running`: The cluster is managed normally.
`Installing`: An installation task is in progress for the cluster.
`Uninstalling`: An uninstallation task is in progress for the cluster.
`Upgrading`: An update task is in progress for the cluster.
`Offline`: The cluster is offline and management is abnormal
parameters.help_zh:
`Running` : 集群纳管正常；
`Installing`: 集群有安装任务正在进行；
`Uninstalling`: 集群有卸载任务正在进行；
`Upgrading`: 集群有更新任务正在进行；
`Offline`: 集群离线，纳管异常
parameters.name: cluster_status

parameters.help_en:
`ACK`: ACK cluster.
`CUSTOM`: Custom cluster (default clusters belong to custom clusters)
parameters.help_zh:
`ACK`: ACK 集群
`CUSTOM`: 自定义集群（默认集群属于自定义集群）
parameters.name: cluster_type

parameters.help_en: [Deprecated] Use the cluster_id parameter to filter instead
parameters.help_zh: 本字段已废弃，请使用 cluster_id 字段过滤
parameters.name: id

RequestId.description_en: The request ID, which can be used for end-to-end diagnostics
RequestId.description_zh: 请求ID，可用于全链路诊断

code.description_en:
The status code.
`code == Success` indicates that the authorization is successful.
Other status codes indicate that the authorization failed. Check the `message` field for the detailed fault information
code.description_zh:
状态码
`code == Success` 则代表授权成功；
其它状态码代表授权失败，授权失败时查看 `message` 字段获取详细的错误信息；

cluster_id.description_en:
The actual cluster ID.

For `ACK` type clusters, this is the ACK cluster ID.
For `CUSTOM` type clusters, this serves as a unique identifier with no additional meaning
cluster_id.description_zh:
实际集群ID。

对于 `ACK` 类型的集群，这个集群ID为 ACK 集群的ID；
对于 `CUSTOM` 类型的集群，这个集群ID作为唯一标识，没有其它额外含义

cluster_status.description_en:
`Running`: The cluster is managed normally.
`Installing`: An installation task is in progress for the cluster.
`Uninstalling`: An uninstallation task is in progress for the cluster.
`Upgrading`: An update task is in progress for the cluster.
`Offline`: The cluster is offline and management is abnormal
cluster_status.description_zh:
`Running` : 集群纳管正常；
`Installing`: 集群有安装任务正在进行；
`Uninstalling`: 集群有卸载任务正在进行；
`Upgrading`: 集群有更新任务正在进行；
`Offline`: 集群离线，纳管异常

cluster_type.description_en:
`ACK`: ACK cluster.
`CUSTOM`: Custom cluster (default clusters belong to custom clusters)
cluster_type.description_zh:
`ACK`: ACK 集群
`CUSTOM`: 自定义集群（默认集群属于自定义集群）

message.description_en:
The error message.
If `code == Success`, this field is empty.
Otherwise, this field contains the request error information
message.description_zh:
错误信息
如果 `code == Success`，则本字段为空；
否则本字段包含请求错误信息
